cohort: Women born in Sweden 1973-83 who gave birth for the first time or remained nulliparous during the years 2001-09
finding: Women with vaginismus/LPV were less likely to give birth, more likely to deliver by caesarean section (especially for maternal request), and more likely to suffer a perineal laceration if they had a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women with vaginismus/LPV were more likely to deliver by caesarean section, particularly for maternal request.
